chapter: Learning from players; Jonah Jones lessons
title: Strutting With Some Barbecue and Beaucoup Jack
summary: Maxwell explains West Coast and Creole slang in Armstrong titles.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well, that's something that always interested me. You know, many black people don't know the meaning of that song, "Strutting With Some Barbeque," but that was a West Coast expression for a good looking girl, barbeque. I remember it, it was popular when I lived there. I guess Louis must have written it when he was out there.
Another tune he wrote was called "Beaucoup Jack".
Yeah, well, that's right. Some French people were saying, what does that mean. I said, well, you ought to know, of all people. Jack means money, beaucoup --
A lot of money, beaucoup Jack, that's right.
That's a New Orleans -- it must have been a Creole expression for a lot of money, yeah.
